🥩🔪 MEET THE MEAT GRINDER® 🔪🥩 SPLORCH!

Got a pile of pets you don't want? Feed them to the Grinder and turn junk into prizes.

HOW IT WORKS (3 steps):
1️⃣ Send pets you don't want to your Discard pile (My Pets → More → Care → Clear the pile).
2️⃣ Open xcpets.fun → Places → 🥩 The Meat Grinder.
3️⃣ Pick how many, press GRIND, sign ONE burn (the price of one egg). Done.

Every pet you grind becomes MEAT: Common 1, Uncommon 2, Rare 5, Legendary 20. Your meat meter keeps counting forever, and it pays out:
🎡 Every 250 meat = a free Pepe Wheel spin
🥚 Every 1,000 meat = a SAUSAGE EGG that hatches on the spot
🌭✨ Every grind = a shot at the GOLDEN SAUSAGE

Gods, Mythics, Wizards and tokenized pets never go in. Ground pets are gone for good. NO REFUNDS. NO REGRETS.

🌭✨ THE GRINDER JUST GOT HUNGRIER 🌭✨

NEW from block 977,456 (tonight, about 8:40 PM Central):

🌭 GOLDEN SAUSAGE = a SURE LEGENDARY HOMER PEPE 🐸👑 Each grind rolls once: 1% for every 100 pets you grind, up to 20% when you grind 2,000.
🥚 SAUSAGE EGGS got juicier: 50% Uncommon, 38% Rare, 12% LEGENDARY. Never Common. And 1 in 77 hatches a HOMER.
🎚️ YOU PICK how many: slide it, or tap 100 / 500 / 1,000 / All. The machine shows your meat, spins, eggs and Golden Sausage odds BEFORE you sign.
🧟 Saving Rares and Legendaries to raise zombies? Tap Keep Legendaries or Keep Rares + Legendaries and they stay safe in your pile.
👀 Press GRIND and your own pets pour into the hopper while the counter races up (even 2,000 takes just a few seconds). CHONK. BLORP. SPLORCH. Then your eggs crack open on screen.

Feed the machine. xcpets.fun → Places → 🥩 The Meat Grinder
